whenToUse: Release notes or a changelog for an API or SaaS product, with type filters and email / RSS subscribe.
Teams that want each release as its own linkable article.
avoidWhen: Live uptime and incidents — use site-status-01.
A full developer product site — use site-devtool-01.
a11y: Filter results and subscribe confirmations are announced through status regions.
Use real dates in each release heading so the list reads well out of context.
